evidencePackageHashing.contractCompatibility: UNCHANGED — Contract still receives the same bytes32 evidencePackageHash field.
evidencePackageHashing.cryptographicLink: The StationAttestation binds evidencePackageHash; the final evidence manifest records the resulting EIP-712 attestation digest. Verification therefore checks both the package preimage hash and the station signature without recursive hashing.
evidencePackageHashing.preimageRule: Clone the schema-compatible Evidence Package manifest and set station.attestationDigest to ZERO_BYTES32 before RFC8785-JCS canonicalization and keccak256 hashing.

policyHashing.preimageRule: Clone the final policy and set hashing.policyHash to ZERO_BYTES32 before RFC8785-JCS canonicalization and keccak256.
policyHashing.verificationRule: Read final policy, save declared policyHash, replace hashing.policyHash with ZERO_BYTES32, JCS-canonicalize, keccak256, and require equality with the declared policyHash.

policySchemaIntegration.reasonForVersionIncrement: The Phase-1 ideal specimen identity requires a serialized ID/QR visible in an overview image. The public MVTec dataset does not provide such transaction-specific physical identifiers, so the hackathon simulation must not claim them.

purpose: Resolve public-dataset specimen-identity limits and non-circular commitment rules before constructing the final active Inspection Policy.

specimenIdentity.productionRule: A production deployment requires a new validated specimen-identity policy with physical identifier and custody controls.
